fact: At the launch of the Chave Móvel Digital on Monday 3 July 2023 the minister said citizens can obtain it in person or online and use a single login to access several digital services on public portals, including the criminal record certificate on Porton di Nôs Ilha, and sign documents.
title: Ministério da Modernização do Estado e Administração Pública lança a Chave Móvel Digital de Cabo Verde
